Annelie
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Good. The ridge above the creek, at sunup. Pack and knife. We travel light."

wedgeSits.name: Annelie
wedgeSits.actionLine: Annelie falls in beside you. "Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground. Let us go find the green."
